literal: Greatness with eminence will depart, useless things, good-nature possessors if speak.
translation: If people of good nature speak useless words, their greatness and eminence will depart from them.
modern: நல்ல பண்புகளை உடையவர்கள் பயனில்லாத சொற்களைப் பேசினால், அவர்களுடைய பெருமையும் சிறப்பும் அவர்களை விட்டு நீங்கிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the consequences of speaking useless words for people of good character. The phrase 'நீர்மை உடையார்' refers to those who possess a naturally good and noble disposition. If such people speak 'பயன் இல' (words without use or benefit), the text states that their inherent greatness along with their special social esteem will depart from them. The verb 'நீங்கும்' (will depart) emphasizes that respect and dignity are not permanent, but depend on the continuous exercise of meaningful speech.
